author: HJJKSL
quote:
GTA 6 is a complete pile of ****.

It feels like a game made by feminist activists who care more about pushing their ideology than preserving what made Grand Theft Auto legendary. Rockstar seems to have forgotten the soul of its own franchise.

GTA used to be about freedom, crime, dark humor, unforgettable characters, and fearless satire. It was rebellious, politically incorrect, and unapologetically offensive. That was exactly what made it special.

Now, instead of delivering another bold and unforgettable crime story, GTA 6 feels sanitized, watered down, and desperate to satisfy modern political expectations. The rebellious spirit that defined the older games seems to have disappeared.

Beautiful graphics cannot compensate for weak writing, uninspiring characters, and a lack of personality.

This is not the Grand Theft Auto I grew up loving. Rockstar has lost its edge, and GTA 6 has lost the soul of the franchise.
